requirements.title: Start charging session on authenticated connection
requirements.description: The station shall start a charging session only after the vehicle is connected and the user is authenticated.

requirements.title: Stop charging on emergency stop
requirements.description: Pressing the emergency stop shall cut power to the connector within 100 ms.

requirements.title: Detect ground fault
requirements.description: The station shall detect ground fault current above 20 mA DC and open the contactor.

requirements.title: Over-temperature derating
requirements.description: If connector temperature exceeds 85 C the charging current shall be reduced by 50 percent.

requirements.title: RFID card authentication
requirements.description: The station shall authenticate users via ISO 14443 RFID cards within 2 seconds.

requirements.title: Display charging status
requirements.description: The display shall show state of charge, power in kW and elapsed time, refreshed every second.

requirements.title: Backend connectivity via OCPP 1.6
requirements.description: The station shall communicate with the central backend using OCPP 1.6 JSON over WebSocket.

requirements.title: Offline charging fallback
requirements.description: If backend connectivity is lost, the station shall continue authorised sessions for up to 24 hours.

requirements.title: Energy metering accuracy
requirements.description: Energy measurement shall be accurate to within 1 percent of the delivered kWh.

requirements.title: Firmware over-the-air update
requirements.description: The station shall support signed firmware updates over the air with rollback on failure.

requirements.title: Audit log of sessions
requirements.description: Every charging session shall be recorded with start, stop, energy and user identifier.

requirements.title: Load management across stations
requirements.description: Total site current shall not exceed the configured grid limit by dynamically sharing power.

requirements.title: User app remote start
requirements.description: Users shall be able to start a session remotely from a mobile app.

requirements.title: Tamper detection
requirements.description: The station shall raise an alarm when the enclosure is opened without authorisation.

requirements.title: Legacy payment terminal support
requirements.description: The station shall support the legacy serial payment terminal.

test_cases.title: Charge with valid card and connected vehicle
test_cases.steps: 1. Connect vehicle. 2. Present valid RFID card.
test_cases.expected_result: Session starts and power is delivered.

test_cases.title: Reject start without authentication
test_cases.steps: 1. Connect vehicle. 2. Do not present card.
test_cases.expected_result: No power delivered; display asks for card.

test_cases.title: Reject start without vehicle
test_cases.steps: 1. Present valid card with no vehicle connected.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop during charging
test_cases.steps: 1. Start session at full current. 2. Press emergency stop.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop latch
test_cases.steps: 1. Press emergency stop. 2. Release it.
test_cases.expected_result: Station stays locked until manual reset.

test_cases.title: Inject 30 mA DC fault
test_cases.steps: 1. Start session. 2. Inject 30 mA DC leakage.
test_cases.expected_result: Contactor opens and fault code E03 is shown.

test_cases.title: Inject 10 mA DC below threshold
test_cases.steps: 1. Start session. 2. Inject 10 mA DC.

test_cases.title: Derate at 90 C connector temperature
test_cases.steps: 1. Charge at 32 A. 2. Heat connector to 90 C.

test_cases.title: No derating at 70 C
test_cases.steps: 1. Charge at 32 A. 2. Hold connector at 70 C.

test_cases.title: Card read time
test_cases.steps: 1. Present valid card. 2. Measure response.

test_cases.title: Unknown card rejected
test_cases.steps: 1. Present unregistered card.

test_cases.title: Display update rate
test_cases.steps: 1. Start session. 2. Observe display for 10 s.

test_cases.title: Display during fault
test_cases.steps: 1. Trigger ground fault.
test_cases.expected_result: Display shows fault instead of charge values.

test_cases.title: OCPP boot notification
test_cases.steps: 1. Power on station with backend reachable.

test_cases.title: OCPP heartbeat
test_cases.steps: 1. Wait for configured heartbeat interval.

test_cases.title: OCPP reconnect after drop
test_cases.steps: 1. Drop WebSocket. 2. Restore.

test_cases.title: Offline session within 24 h
test_cases.steps: 1. Disconnect backend. 2. Start authorised session.
test_cases.expected_result: Session works and is queued for upload.

test_cases.title: Offline session after 24 h
test_cases.steps: 1. Disconnect backend for 25 h. 2. Try to start.

test_cases.title: Meter accuracy at 7 kW
test_cases.steps: 1. Charge at 7 kW against reference meter.

test_cases.title: Meter accuracy at 22 kW
test_cases.steps: 1. Charge at 22 kW against reference meter.

test_cases.title: Meter accuracy at low current
test_cases.steps: 1. Charge at 6 A against reference meter.

test_cases.title: Valid signed firmware update
test_cases.steps: 1. Push signed firmware package.
test_cases.expected_result: Station updates and reports new version.

test_cases.title: Unsigned firmware rejected
test_cases.steps: 1. Push unsigned package.

test_cases.title: Rollback on failed update
test_cases.steps: 1. Push package that fails on boot.
test_cases.expected_result: Station rolls back to previous version.

test_cases.title: Session record created
test_cases.steps: 1. Complete a session.
test_cases.expected_result: Record exists with start, stop, kWh and user ID.

test_cases.title: Records survive reboot
test_cases.steps: 1. Complete session. 2. Reboot station.

test_cases.title: Session start timing
test_cases.steps: 1. Connect and authenticate. 2. Measure time to power.

test_cases.title: Fault after reset
test_cases.steps: 1. Trigger fault. 2. Reset. 3. Start session.
test_cases.expected_result: Station charges normally after clearing fault.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop when idle
test_cases.steps: 1. Press emergency stop with no session.

test_cases.title: Meter data retention
test_cases.steps: 1. Record energy. 2. Power cycle.

risk_items.title: Electric shock from ground fault
risk_items.description: Undetected leakage current could injure users.

risk_items.title: Fire from connector overheating
risk_items.description: Poor contact or derating failure could overheat the connector.

risk_items.title: Inaccurate billing
risk_items.description: Meter error causes customers to be over or under charged.

risk_items.title: Unauthorised charging
risk_items.description: Weak authentication allows free or fraudulent sessions.

risk_items.title: Malicious firmware
risk_items.description: An attacker installs unsigned firmware to take over the station.

risk_items.title: Backend outage blocks all charging
risk_items.description: Station refuses sessions when the backend is unreachable.

risk_items.title: Grid overload at site
risk_items.description: Several stations draw more than the grid connection allows.

risk_items.title: Emergency stop failure
risk_items.description: Contactor welds closed and power is not cut.

risk_items.title: Loss of session records
risk_items.description: Records lost on reboot cause disputes and compliance issues.

risk_items.title: Misleading display
risk_items.description: Wrong values shown cause user confusion.

risk_items.title: Obsolete terminal security hole
risk_items.description: Legacy serial terminal has known vulnerabilities.
